features.label: Translations panels

patches.author: Osmond Arnesto
patches.subject: Replace button.footer with moz-button in browser/components/translations/

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Refactor full-page Translations eligibility checks to accept a browser

features.summary: The translation panel now uses Firefox’s standard button component, keeping its controls consistent with the rest of the browser. Full-page translation checks also evaluate the specific browser tab, helping Firefox decide more accurately when translation is available.

features.label: Translations UI tests

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Prevent full-page translations on PDF documents

features.summary: Firefox now avoids applying full-page translations to PDF documents, which aren’t ordinary webpages and may not translate correctly. This keeps the translation feature focused on content it can handle reliably.

features.label: Translations actors

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Replace prefix: with logModule: in the console.createInstance calls (Automatic fixes).

features.summary: Translation actors now use the console’s `logModule` setting for their log labels, aligning their messages with the current logging format. This is an internal maintenance change, with no expected user-visible difference.

features.label: Translations engine tests
features.summary: The translation engine test process now releases its keepalive as soon as it is no longer needed, rather than staying active longer than necessary. This makes the tests cleaner and helps avoid unnecessary process lifetime.

features.label: Translations UI tests

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Prevent full-page translations on PDF documents

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Re-enable tests disabled on ccov builds that pass there on try.

patches.author: hannajones
patches.subject: Cleanup translations tests that rely on the SRD pref being false

features.summary: Firefox now avoids applying full-page translations to PDF documents, which may not translate correctly like ordinary webpages. The related work also restores and tidies translation tests so they run more reliably across different test builds; _these test changes don’t add a visible feature_.

features.label: Translations actors

patches.author: Damien Carver
patches.subject: Replace prefix: with logModule: in the console.createInstance calls (Automatic fixes).

patches.author: Chris H-C
patches.subject: Test that OHTTP is used for pings that request OHTTP

features.summary: Translation actors now use the console’s `logModule` setting for log labels, and tests verify that pings requesting OHTTP use Oblivious HTTP, a method designed to hide a request’s contents and the requester’s identity from any single intermediary. These changes improve logging consistency and confidence in the privacy protection for those pings.

features.label: Translations panels

patches.author: Osmond Arnesto
patches.subject: Replace button.footer with moz-button in browser/components/translations/

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Refactor full-page Translations eligibility checks to accept a browser

features.summary: The translation panel now uses Firefox’s standard button component, keeping its controls consistent with the rest of the browser. Full-page translation checks also evaluate the specific browser tab, helping Firefox decide more accurately when translation is available.

features.label: Translations engine

patches.author: Exploding-Joysticks
patches.subject: Change ConsoleLogLevel and maxLogLevel strings from PascalCase to camelCase

features.summary: The translations engine now uses camelCase rather than PascalCase for its console log-level setting names, making them consistent with the naming style used elsewhere. This is an internal cleanup; it does not change how translations work or appear to users.

features.label: Translations engine & about:translations

patches.author: Mark Banner
patches.subject: Switch from eslint-plugin-import to eslint-plugin-import-x (comment-only changes for ESLint).

features.summary: The translations engine and about:translations page are unchanged for users. The work switches ESLint’s import-checking plugin to a compatible alternative and updates comments, keeping the project’s code-quality checks current.

features.label: Translations engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: no bug - docs: use internal references for in-tree docs instead of firefox-source-docs URLs DONTBUILD

features.summary: In-tree documentation now links to other Firefox source docs using internal references instead of fixed firefox-source-docs URLs. This helps links stay connected to the documentation as it is built and maintained within the source tree; it does not change Firefox behavior.

features.label: Translations engine tests
features.summary: The translation engine test process now releases its keepalive as soon as it is no longer needed, rather than staying active longer than necessary. This makes the tests cleaner and helps avoid unnecessary process lifetime.
